topic: Neymar 2025 Santos skills and goals compilation, music-driven fast edit
hook: Neymar in cyan goalkeeper-style/away kit smiling at crowd, then fast cuts of Santos action
subtitle_style: No subtitles; occasional lower-third name tag "10 NEYMAR" with Santos badge at ~6 s
reaction_overlays: Flash-white transition, slow-mo, zoom, speed ramps, colour-graded; no emoji
transition_summary: Very fast: dozens of cuts, cuts at 1.5-3.9 s every 0.1-0.2 s (flash/strobe intro), then cuts every 1-3 s; beat-synced with whip, flash and slow-mo

reuse_segments.what: Fast flashy intro montage of Neymar close-ups and plays
reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: needs licensed footage; or recreate with generated imagery

reuse_segments.what: Neymar skills/goals clips for Santos from TV and phone feeds
